question: Does a trend filter help intraday FX mean reversion?

sources.title: Mean reversion in five-minute EURUSD bars
sources.text: Fading two-standard-deviation moves on five-minute EURUSD bars earned 0.6 pips per trade before costs from 2015 to 2022. With a 0.5 pip round-trip cost the edge is close to zero.

sources.title: Trend filters for short-horizon reversal
sources.text: Skipping reversal entries when the four-hour trend is strong removed 40% of trades and raised the average trade to 1.1 pips across six currency pairs.

sources.title: A practitioner note on session effects
sources.text: Reversal signals behave differently in the Asian session, where ranges are narrow and spreads widen around the Tokyo fix.
